evidence.condition_part: net_profit_or_loss is not null and net_profit_or_loss is not equal to 0
evidence.exact_span: The higher than average loss was driven primarily by the revaluation of our non-monetary items, such as deferred acquisition costs and unearned premium reserve, back to historic rates. From 2023, this revaluation of our non-monetary items will no longer take place as IFRS 17 mandates that all insurance items are now treated as monetary.
